inputs.name: node_version
inputs.description: Node.js release to install, such as "26.13.0". Change checksums with it.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the linux-x64 and linux-arm64 .tar.gz tarballs, from the release's SHASUMS256.txt. Change these with node_version.

inputs.name: global_packages
inputs.description: npm packages to install globally, by name, each at an exact version, such as { semver = "7.8.5" }.
